method.clock: WS trial-relative events and t=(index+1)/500. No continuous HS clock conversion needed. WS LED/start times checked against AllLifts.
method.position_units: raw tracker cm, per dataset paper Figures 2 and hand-velocity cm/s; reduced model targets remain normalized
method.force_check: derived LF must match FX1+FX2 per sample within 2e-5 N
method.caution: lift/replace landmarks were derived using object Z; displacement corroborates author convention and sign but is not an independent inference of the axis.
